title: The Signal Sent Ten Thousand Times: A Fast Sensor, a Queued Connection and a Latest Value That Counts What It Replaced
fallback: This lesson is about queued signals and the Qt event loop, so it needs Qt. Lesson 08-09 is the same question in plain C++: the newest reading or all of them. Without Qt, do that and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: a thread safe latest value that posts one update to its own thread however often it is written, and says how many writes each update stands for
